components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #ced3dc; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; color: #000; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #09234f; border-color: #09234f; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #13306a; border-color: #13306a; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #384ce3; border-color: #384ce3; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #384ce3; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #ced3dc; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; color: #000; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-btn:hover { border-color: #000; } .ds-btn:active { background: #eff5f0; } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #384ce3; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Mono label above a square-cornered input.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; } .ds-field span { font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #595959; } .ds-field input { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #ced3dc; border-radius: 4px; font: 16px 'Uncut Sans', sans-serif; color: #000; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #595959; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: #384ce3; outline: 1px solid #384ce3; }

components.name: Status
components.description: Square marker plus one mono word; never a pill.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #000; } .ds-status::before { content: ''; width: 8px; height: 8px; background: #1888a2; }

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Sticky paper rail under the navy field.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e5e5; } .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 52px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; background: none; color: #595959; font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #000; } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true'] { color: #000; border-bottom-color: #384ce3; } .ds-count { padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 2px; background: #384ce3; color: #fff; font-size: 11px; }

components.name: Console
components.description: Today's totals on the navy field with a rule grid.
components.css: .ds-console { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); margin: 0; padding: 0 20px; color: #fff; background-image: linear-gradient(rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.05) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, #09234f 0%, #384ce3 100%); background-size: 48px 48px, 48px 48px, 100% 100%; } .ds-console div { padding: 24px 20px 32px; border-left: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.2); } .ds-console div:first-child { border-left: 0; padding-left: 0; } .ds-console dt { font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #c4f0ff; } .ds-console dd { margin: 12px 0 0; font-family: 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; font-size: 36px; font-weight: 515; } .ds-console small { margin-right: 6px; font-family: 'Geist Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; color: #c4f0ff; vertical-align: 0.9em; }

narrative.overview:
Paysync is a bank ledger opened on a live verification console. Records sit on white, ruled paper: square, separated by 1px lines, never floating in cards. The day's position lives in one navy field at the top, with a faint grid of rules, like a console reading out the ledger. The world comes from the owner's chosen reference, Baselayer (styles.refero.design), adapted to a dense operations tool with free, self-hosted stand-in fonts.

It refuses the rounded-card SaaS dashboard: pill badges, stacks of shadowed cards, a filled accent button on every row, grey captions restating what the screen already says.
keyCharacteristics: White paper canvas, ink text, one navy field (header and today's totals) with a 48px rule grid.
Serif for figures and entry headings, sans for reading, mono uppercase for labels and actions.
Square records and 1px rules; 4px corners only on controls.
Status is a small square marker plus a mono word, never a pill.
One navy filled button, only where something is committed (Allocate, Approve, Request).

rules.name: The One Field Rule
rules.body: Navy owns exactly one region per screen (the masthead and totals, or the sign-in side). Everything else is paper.

rules.name: The Figures Rule
rules.body: Money in tables is set in mono and right-aligned; money as a headline figure is serif. Never proportional sans for amounts in columns.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: If something needs to stand apart, give it a rule or a surface color, never a shadow.

dos: Do keep records square and ruled; use Mint Paper for anything being edited.
Do say a status as a marker plus one mono word ("Verified", "Waiting", "Part paid").
Do show times relative ("2 days ago") with the exact East Africa time on hover.
Do show payer-typed text in mono as plain data, and never in an approval's change list.
Do keep copy to what the person needs to act: no captions that restate the screen.
donts: Don't use shadows, pills, rounded cards, or gradients outside the navy field.
Don't put a filled button on every row; navy is for the commit.
Don't use Registry Blue as a general button color; it marks the active thing.
Don't put a label or kicker above a heading.
Don't add a second navy region to a screen.
